newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Creditanstalt revises up '96 net profit.
newsitem.headline: Creditanstalt revises up '96 net profit.

text.p: Austrian bank Creditanstalt's earnings for 1996 have turned out better than the provisional figures released in January, chief executive Guido Schmidt-Chiari said on Sunday.

In an interview in current affairs magazine Profil to be published on Monday, the banker said: "The final figures have now turned out to be somewhat better. Return on equity will be nearly 11 percent."
Net profit would reach around 2.9 billion schillings, up from the 2.6 billion provisionally reported in January.
